SELECT d.DELIVERY_ID, d.DELIVERY_STATUS, d.TRACKING_NO, d.CARRIER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(d.SHIPPED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS SHIPPED_AT, DATE_FORMAT(d.DELIVERED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS DELIVERED_AT, DATE_FORMAT(d.PICKED_UP_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS PICKED_UP_AT, d.RECEIVER_NAME, d.ADDRESS, d.ORDER_ID,
